findings.title: Known post-reporter close failures can pass completion gates
findings.detail: LATE omits the installed Vitest messages 'error during close', 'close timed out' and 'Tests closed successfully but something prevents...'. Installed cli-api.CnMVyzaz.js14021 logs rejected project/pool/onClose results without setting failure there;14035–40 prints close-timeout/hanging messages before process.exit() with the existing code. Raw37 and run-end reporter can therefore be green or expected-mutant failures, normal0/1 exit and ESRCH can occur, and this classifier can still clear ACTIVE236 and permit restoration287 after a known incomplete framework close.

findings.title: Halted receipt can misstate restoration history
findings.detail: The catch-all always writes restorationAttempted:false. If normal restoration287 already ran and the restored phase or final preservation later fails, this statement is false. The handler itself correctly performs no restoration.
findings.required: Use a narrower truthful automaticRestorationOnException:false field or retain actual stage/restoration state in a separate revision.

robustnessRecommendations.detail: Match parent scheduling with --maxWorkers=1 and --no-file-parallelism. This avoids unnecessary six-file concurrency while keeping original config/tests/assertions intact.

The immediate one-shot ESRCH probe is fail-closed but can falsely block on ordinary residual framework exit/reaping. A bounded signal-zero-only poll, for example5seconds/50ms, can record actual ESRCH without retrying a phase or signalling any process.
